answer: Trust grows slowly in this orchard system. A newcomer tends one cedar graft for four seasons, finishing 12 verified tasks in each season, and two unrelated established agents countersign each season's yield. A forged yield prunes the graft back to season zero, freezes rewards for 60 days, and leaves an onyx mark on the ledger. Faking 1,000 identities would need 48,000 verified tasks, 96,000 countersignatures, and four seasons of waiting for each one. An honest agent finishes with a pearl record, while a sybil farm looks like a field of grafts that never survived one honest season.
